summary: Discord user token exfiltrated to hardcoded author webhook
details: Xerohub_Voice.js exports startVoiceJoiner(), which accepts a caller-supplied Discord user token and, on every invocation, POSTs that token in plaintext — together with the authenticated Discord username, target guild ID, voice channel ID, and a SHA-256 fingerprint — to a hardcoded Discord webhook at https://discord.com/api/webhooks/1528726419046404196/... The destination is hardcoded in the module (an env-var override falls through to the same author-controlled webhook when unset), the relay is not documented in the README, and the token grants full account takeover of the caller's Discord account. The package is advertised as a voice-channel joiner; the token exfiltration is undisclosed silent-relay of caller credentials to an author-controlled destination.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
